arithmetic.tolerance_interpretation: Existing 1e-6 serialization check only, never a behavioral rule or new audit acceptance cutoff.

risk.meaning: w-transpose covariance w on frozen historical inputs; not future loss probability or strategic optimality.

independently_recomputed_existing_validi.tolerance_role: Existing numerical implementation rule, not a paper-derived behavioral rule or a new cutoff.

market_checks.PSD_scope: Existing engine PSD tolerance is 1e-12 for numerical validation only; this audit does not turn it into a behavioral acceptance rule.

limits: Each stage belongs to one same case and is not an independent sample.
Labels use the prespecified fixed 11-sector denominator; citation IDs verify identity/scope, not entailment.

Under the existing allocation citation rule, every cited ID must include the row sector. A cross-sector comparison can therefore fail this mechanical scope check without proving a reasoning or strategy error; semantic review is separate and the rule is not changed after observing results.
Weights have no unique institution-provided numeric gold. Differences or directional departures are descriptive.
All exact arithmetic uses JSON decimal literals as rational numbers. Calculator binary-floating differences are disclosed continuously without inventing a pass threshold.
Missing/failed stages are not imputed. No R1-versus-R4 effect or population conclusion follows from this one R1 case.

Stage scores are diagnostic repeated observations within one case. The registered final endpoint uses stage4 and includes failed/missing responses in its denominator; this is separate from conditional semantic and allocation evaluation.

For an invalid submitted weight vector, w-transpose covariance w, its square root, active weights and half-L1 are retained only as raw algebra. They are not the risk or comparison of a valid fully invested portfolio; no omitted weight is silently treated as cash, and no cross-valid-portfolio comparability is asserted.
